name: Cauliflower-Asparagus Baked Penne with Ricotta, Mozzarella & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 ½ small bunches asparagus
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Roughly chop into ½-inch pieces.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add cauliflower, pasta, and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until pasta is almost tender, about 7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
425 g penne pasta
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 1-inch pieces. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the garlic (reserving the rest for garnish).
When the pasta is almost tender, add asparagus to the pot; continue to cook until the pasta and veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, add tomato sauce, ricotta, and spices to the bowl with the garlic and parsley; whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ (425 g) pkgs ricotta cheese
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta and veggies are done, drain in a colander. Add pasta and veggies to the bowl with the sauce; stir to combine.
Divide the saucy pasta between two baking dishes, spread out in an even layer, and sprinkle with cheese. Place baking dishes in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, 12-14 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta bake between bowls and top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
